summary: Iteration 2: Re-tested CG Revision Booklet after Pocket Cheat Card + Unit 2 addition. Replaced the stale old-schema backend suite with a new pytest suite (14 tests) covering /api/, /api/units listing/sorting, both unit documents, compact topic schema (quick_facts), cheat_card/last_minute_revision/must_memorize, Bresenham & Midpoint-circle solved-example tables, diagram_key mapping and 404 handling — 14/14 passed. Frontend verified on desktop (1920) and mobile (390) plus print-media emulation: cheat card renders immediately after cover with Formulas/Memory Hooks columns, sidebar cheat-card-btn scrolls correctly, unit switcher loads Unit 2 (title, 8 sidebar topics, scroll-to-top, 8-Topics badge), all Unit-2 topic cards render (homogeneous correctly has no diagram, clipping shows region-codes SVG), scroll-spy + nav land at section tops (y=96, no over-scroll), mobile menu includes Pocket Cheat Card, zero console/page errors, no horizontal overflow, header/sidebar hidden in print.

issues: Inner SVG label text (e.g. 'Same relative position...' note in the Window-to-Viewport diagram) scales down to ~3-4px and is illegible on mobile; consider larger base font in the SVG or hiding micro-annotations below sm breakpoint

critical_code_review_comments: Bresenham topic reuses diagram_key 'dda-grid' (verified intentional — caption reads 'SAME LINE (2,3)->(8,6) — BRESENHAM PICKS THE SAME PIXELS, WITH INTEGERS ONLY'); keep in mind if the DDA diagram is ever edited it affects both units.
Spec said Unit 2 cheat_card should have formulas/hooks lists; actual counts are 7/7 (Unit 1 is 6/6) — no assertion violated, tests allow >=6.
seed_data_creation: None — units are seeded idempotently by backend lifespan
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now matches the compact schema (quick_facts, final_sections = cheat_card/last_minute_revision/must_memorize) and both units; run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend testids: unit-switcher, unit-tab-{unit_id}, cheat-card-section, cheat-card-btn, topic-nav-item-{id}, topic-card-{id}, diagram-frame, mobile-menu, mobile-menu-btn. Section tops land at y=96 (sticky header offset) which is expected, not over-scroll. Only open item is a minor mobile SVG-label legibility nit.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. Previous mobile over-scroll bug (iteration 1) confirmed fixed — deferred scrollIntoView + scroll-mt-24 lands all sections at y=96 on both mobile and desktop.
